ST_SetSRID(ST_GeomFromGeoJSON(#{facility.geometryGeoJson}), 4326)
NULL , #{facility.status}, #{facility.version}, #{facility.createdAt}, #{facility.updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT path FROM organization WHERE id = #{organizationId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
SELECT organization_id FROM facility WHERE id = #{parentFacilityId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT facility.id, facility.tenant_id, facility.organization_id, facility.parent_id, facility.code, facility.display_name, facility.facility_type, facility.zone_id, ST_AsGeoJSON(facility.geometry) AS geometry_geo_json, facility.status, facility.version, facility.created_at, facility.updated_at, organization.path AS organization_path FROM facility JOIN organization ON organization.id = facility.organization_id AND organization.tenant_id = facility.tenant_id WHERE facility.id = #{facilityId}

SELECT facility.id, facility.tenant_id, facility.organization_id, facility.parent_id, facility.code, facility.display_name, facility.facility_type, facility.zone_id, ST_AsGeoJSON(facility.geometry) AS geometry_geo_json, facility.status, facility.version, facility.created_at, facility.updated_at, organization.path AS organization_path FROM facility JOIN organization ON organization.id = facility.organization_id AND organization.tenant_id = facility.tenant_id WHERE facility.geometry IS NOT NULL AND facility.status = 'ACTIVE' AND ( (#{minLongitude} <= #{maxLongitude} AND facility.geometry && ST_MakeEnvelope(#{minLongitude}, #{minLatitude}, #{maxLongitude}, #{maxLatitude}, 4326)) OR (#{minLongitude} > #{maxLongitude} AND (facility.geometry && ST_MakeEnvelope(#{minLongitude}, #{minLatitude}, 180, #{maxLatitude}, 4326) OR facility.geometry && ST_MakeEnvelope(-180, #{minLatitude}, #{maxLongitude}, #{maxLatitude}, 4326))) ) ORDER BY facility.code
